name.la: De solitudine et silentio (Epistola de recommendatione solitudinis)

description.la: Epistola ad quendam a ministerio suo absolutum de recommendatione solitudinis et silentii, per capitula.
description.en-US: A long letter to a brother just relieved of his office, in praise of solitude and silence: the quiet cell, guarding the tongue and the heart, reading, prayer and the company of God. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1918), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Longa carta a um irmão recém-dispensado de seu ofício, em louvor da solidão e do silêncio: a cela tranquila, a guarda da língua e do coração, a leitura, a oração e a companhia de Deus.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis De solitudine et silentio, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1918), Opera omnia IV; archive.org raw OCR (Pohl 1918 volume).
sources.description: Chapters as Pohl divides them, with his upper-case chapter titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical footnotes and introduction are not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals at chapter openings and isolated letters are often garbled; a chapter heading lost to OCR runs two chapters together.
